answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the beacon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the grove re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
